name: ticketing-infra-360-mcp
description: Create and list LinkIT360 infra tickets from your AI agent.
long_description: MCP server for LinkIT360 Ticketing-Infra. Create infra tickets and list/search tickets (newest-first, real pagination) via browser automation. Enter your LinkIT360 email and password below; the first time, ask the agent to "log in to LinkIT360" to solve the one-time reCAPTCHA in a real browser. The login session is saved and reused.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Open a browser to log in to LinkIT360 (solve the reCAPTCHA once).

tools.name: check_session
tools.description: Check whether the LinkIT360 session is authenticated.

email.title: LinkIT360 Email
email.description: The email you use to log in at report.linkit360.com

password.title: LinkIT360 Password
password.description: Your LinkIT360 password (stored securely by Claude Desktop).

base_url.title: LinkIT360 Base URL
base_url.description: Leave as default unless told otherwise.
